Hello, this is TENUTO.

Time really flies, doesn’t it?

As time goes by, in 2020, we will take one more step towards creating a space that lives up to the meaning of the name Tenuto.
We want to make it happen.
It's a classic bar.
When you think of a bar as a classic bar, many people think of a classic bar.
What I think and mean by a classic bar is a bar where classical music plays.
​
There are many great artists in Korea who create classical music with love and passion.
However, it is true that there are not many spaces in Korea where classical music can be accessed comfortably and easily.

reviews.author: Namaste
reviews.text:
☕️ Coffee + 🍸 Bar Mood + 🎶 LP Feeling all in one place!
This is not just a cafe. Malt Coffee Bar is an ‘emotional charging station’!

1. First impression — A stylish bar cafe in the city center

What greets you as soon as you enter the entrance is
**Neon sign reading “MALT COFFEE BAR”** and stylish bar table lines✨

🪑 When you sit in the bar-type seat,
You can watch the barista carefully brew your coffee right in front of you.
This cafe really feels like a ‘bar’ — there are even high-end whiskeys lined up on the shelves in the back.
For a moment, I felt like I was in a mini lounge in the city.

2. Emotional core! LP bar elements🎶

The real charm of this place is the LP bar feel!
🎼 Vinyl collection filling one wall
A turntable that allows you to play music yourself,
And even a vacuum tube amp!

Warm sound unique to analog sound
It fills the space calmly.

Various LPs such as jazz, R&B, and city pop are played.
The depth of music you listen to with a sip of coffee is extraordinary.
This is ‘listening coffee.’

3. Beverage — A glass of sensuous and refreshing latte

What I ordered was an iced vanilla latte.
🥛 Just the right amount of ice in a tall glass!
What you feel at first sip is a soft vanilla scent.
And then the rich flavor of espresso spreads in your mouth☕️

🧊 The sweetness is understated, and the savory taste of milk
The bitterness of coffee is balanced...
‘Sophisticated Latte’ itself!

4. Other details
• The menu design is also neat!
• Desserts are simple but neatly prepared, including cookies and scones.
• All baristas 🙆🏻 friendly and professional
• The lighting is soft, so it feels like time passes slowly when you sit there.

5. Overall review — “A cafe where you can enjoy LP-like vibes”

This cafe is not just a place to come for coffee.
It's a place where you can enjoy the space, music, and atmosphere.

🎷 People who like LP sensibility
📸 Those looking for a bar seat that takes good photos
☕️ For those who want a proper cup of latte

I highly recommend Malt Coffee Bar!

Overall rating

Flavor: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Mood: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (plus bonus stars!)
Music/LP Sensitivity: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Intention to revisit: YES, ABSOLUTELY!!

reviews.author: Namaste
reviews.text:
I went to the Yeouido branch of Wine Bar Makchacha.
I was curious because this is a place where you can enjoy wine pairing with Korean food as a base, but the perfection exceeded my expectations.

The most impressive menu was the combination of raw meat and brisket.
The freshness of the raw meat was evident from the color, and the sesame oil flavor was not overpowering, so the original taste of the meat was preserved well. The brisket served on the side was lightly grilled without any unpleasant smell, and had a nice contrasting texture with the raw meat, making it fun to eat the two in turns. The sauce and seasoned chives served as a side are well balanced and not overpowering.

Cheese potato pancakes (or cheese-based pancakes) are obvious from the looks of it.
A generous amount of cheese is placed on pancakes that are crispy on the outside and moist on the inside. Even though it can be greasy, it is less burdensome than expected thanks to the herbs and the degree of grilling. A menu that goes very well with wine.

The side dishes such as tortilla, potato salad, and kimchi provided as standard are also provided without any waste. Although it is simple, it is made with a lot of effort, so the drinking party continues naturally.

For the wine, I chose Brunello di Montalcino 2018 (Il Poggione).
The tannin was refined and the body was good, so it went well with meat snacks. The staff was not overly responsive and provided accurate explanations, making it easy to choose a wine. It is also convenient to be able to check wine information right away on the tablet menu.

overall
• Reasonable price compared to the quality of the snacks
• Wine list is of high standard and well maintained.
• A great atmosphere for quiet conversation in Yeouido

It gives the impression that it is a good place to eat and drink properly rather than just having a quick drink.
There is enough intention to visit again.

The savory brisket and fresh raw meat bring out the flavor of the wine, and the fresh mozzarella cheese on the sweet and spicy tteokbokki is truly a ‘cheat’. A sip of wine, a snack... reviews.author: Sang Y. Choi
reviews.text:
Even in an age where online shopping has become a daily routine, there are places that make you want to take a step. The Hyundai Seoul in Yeouido is a reference point that shows the potential of such offline spaces.
This building is the work of Richard Rogers, who gained international fame by designing the Pompidou Center with Renzo Piano in his youth. The characteristics of high-tech architecture he has pursued are clearly evident here. Rather than hiding the structure, it is exposed to the outside and the function itself is sublimated into design.
In particular, The Hyundai Seoul created a huge internal space through the truss method. Eight triangular trusses supported the three-part ceiling, creating a cool, open space without columns. In addition, the slab is left empty between the 5th and 6th floors, creating an open view that connects the top and bottom at a glance.
But the real charm of this space is not just its size. The rest areas placed here and there are reminiscent of a park in the city rather than a shopping mall. In particular, when looking down from the north photo spot on the 6th floor, the central space feels like a theme park with a merry-go-round. With the addition of the ALT.1 exhibition space, this becomes a place where consumption and culture naturally come together.
It is connected to IFC Mall and the subway underground, providing excellent accessibility. There are brands targeting the younger generation, so it is filled with people during lunch time, and the number of foreign visitors has increased noticeably recently.
Maybe that's why my wife and I naturally come here when the weather is bad. It's raining, too hot, or extremely cold—in such cases, The Hyundai Seoul becomes a place where you can enjoy walking and relaxing beyond shopping.
After all, this is not just a department store.
It is a ‘daily space in the city’ open to Seoul citizens who can stop by at any time.

reviews.author: Youngmi Choi
reviews.text:
🌿Yeouido The Hyundai Seoul Visit Story
A department store where you can ‘experience space’ beyond shopping, a place where you want to spend the day

The Hyundai Seoul, located in Yeouido, is now a space that cannot be described simply as a department store. The first thing you feel the moment you enter this place is, “Oh, this place is a little different.” When you open the door and enter, the view opens upward and you feel as if you have entered a huge art museum or modern cultural space. The layered structure is designed around curves rather than straight lines, so the entire space flows smoothly and smoothly. Thanks to this, even though it is a place where many people come and go, it feels strangely relaxed and comfortable.
The round lights that fill the ceiling brighten the space without being excessive. The scenery created by soft light reflecting off the marble floor is truly impressive. The round lights forming on the floor look like starlight, and when you see this scene, you stop walking and look at it one more time. It looks pretty in pictures, but the atmosphere when you see it in person is much more luxurious and calm.
The space where luxury stores are gathered is also impressive. Although world-class brands such as Louis Vuitton and Prada are located here, it does not feel burdensome or ostentatious at all. Each store is structured more like an exhibition space than a shopping space, making it naturally fun to look around. There is ample space between brands and the movement lines are well-organized, so it feels less stuffy even when there are a lot of people. So, even if you don't have any intention of purchasing it, it's good to look around slowly and enjoy the space.
One of the biggest charms of The Hyundai Seoul is that it incorporates nature indoors. The green space created in the middle of the room makes you forget for a moment that you are inside a department store. This space, where plants, trees, dirt paths, and wooden decks come together, is like a small garden in the city. As I walk along the path between the plants, I feel like the fatigue accumulated from shopping is naturally relieved. It's a great place to come with children or to walk quietly alone.
The area where lighting and lifestyle brands are gathered is also not to be missed. The sight of lights of various designs turned on makes it look like an interior showroom. Each light creates a different atmosphere in the space, naturally making you think, “I want one in my house.” The unique charm of The Hyundai Seoul is that it is not simply a space where items are displayed, but is felt as a sensuous presentation.
Overall, The Hyundai Seoul is more of a place to spend the day than a place for shopping. Thanks to the wide circulation, ample space, and design that utilizes nature and light, just walking makes you feel good. A place where you don’t have to buy anything or go anywhere. If you just walk slowly, look around, and rest, time will fly by. It feels special to be able to find such a sophisticated yet comfortable space in the middle of Yeouido.
The Hyundai Seoul can speak clearly.
This is not a ‘department store,’ but a scenery where you can take a moment to catch your breath in the city.

Disney Store is a store where you can find Disney characters loved around the world in a variety of products.
As everyone knows, Disney is an American comprehensive media and entertainment company established after its founder, Walt Disney.
In particular, I have seen it a lot as an educational material since I was young, and as a generation who grew up watching Disney cartoons, I feel like I am going back to my childhood every time I see the characters.

Disney Store The Hyundai Seoul branch, which opened in September 2023, has become a representative store that is always crowded with people regardless of whether it is a weekday or a weekend.

I've been to Japan a lot recently, but honestly, there are more varieties than the Disney stores I've visited each time.

It's fun to look at the products, but taking pictures at the photo zones in each corner is another fun thing to do.

And there was a Toy Story photo zone that made me imagine that my toys really wouldn't move when I wasn't around.
Although it was just a signboard, the photo showed that it was taken with characters, so it was a Disneyland that could be enjoyed indirectly in Seoul.

Disney Store The Hyundai Seoul Branch, where you can look back on your memories and return to your childhood.

.

.
